name: WeaveSync SCADA Zero-Mock Industrial Overhaul
description: Strict production-grade overhaul of WeaveSync SCADA for Ali Haider Industries: zero mock data, true hardware auto-registration, truthful dual-mode connectivity, industrial Shadcn UI, and hardened WT32-ETH01 firmware.

userStories.title: Eliminate All Mock Data & Implement True Hardware Auto-Registration
acceptanceCriteria: Delete createInitialLoomState, hardcoded 36-loom arrays, fake climate, solar chart, fake Pareto, and fake FRAM numbers
Move hardcoded 36-loom SQL seed from migrations to docs/fleet-reference.md
Auto-register looms strictly on valid authenticated packet at POST /api/ingest/v1/batch with MAC deviceId
Track connectivity purely by last_heartbeat_at: ONLINE (<15s), STALE (15-60s), OFFLINE (>60s with RPM 0)
Display authoritative 'No Looms Connected' empty state with listening indicator and endpoint URL when 0 looms connected
Allow operators to configure/label auto-registered devices (Loom #, Model, Article, Set RPM, Weft Density)

userStories.title: Truthful Dual-Mode Data Transport (Cloud vs. Local LAN)
acceptanceCriteria: Remove fake LOCAL/CLOUD toggle from header
Support primary Supabase Realtime and automatic fallback to local in-memory/SQLite store via GET /api/live/state
Display single read-only status pill in header: Cloud Live (green), Local LAN Mode (blue), Disconnected (red)

userStories.title: Industrial UI/UX Redesign with Shadcn UI (Zero Slop)
acceptanceCriteria: High-contrast light industrial canvas (bg-zinc-50), pure white flat cards (bg-white border border-zinc-200), dark typography
Zero emojis, zero duplicate icons, zero internal document tags (Section 11, CEO pitch), zero raw protocol badges (LDL+BICOM_ETH)
Top KPI strip with 4 clean cards (Fleet Efficiency, Looms Running, Active Stoppages, Shift Output)
Connected machine cards with Name, Model, Status, Efficiency %, RPM, Meters, Stop stopwatch, and 'Log Stop Reason' dialog with 7 ISO codes
Machine detail page read-only with Hardware Diagnostics tab showing only real pin telemetry
Shift Analytics page with Huawei solar chart deleted, real DB metrics for PKT shifts, clean empty state when no data
All clocks locked to Asia/Karachi without hydration warnings
Add custom src/app/not-found.tsx, loading skeletons, and verify productionBrowserSourceMaps is false

userStories.title: Harden ESP32 Firmware (wt32_eth01_pilot.ino)
acceptanceCriteria: Start totalPicks at 0 and send incremental picksDelta with monotonic seq
Read real Ethernet MAC ETH.macAddress() as deviceId
Strict safe pins: GPIO 4 (STRT), 32 (PP), 33 (WD), 14 (FD), never touching GPIO 0, 2, 12, 15
Hardware PCNT without double-counting ISR
Explicit #ifndef PHY macros before #include <ETH.h>
5-second heartbeat + immediate edge state push with x-weavesync-key

userStories.title: Security, Validation, Edge Gateway & External Verification
acceptanceCriteria: Zod validation for /api/ingest/v1/batch and /api/operator/declare-stop with 400 on malformed payloads
Enforce x-weavesync-key header matching INGEST_API_KEY
npm run build passes with 0 errors
cd edge-gateway && npx tsc --noEmit passes with 0 errors
scripts/verify-pilot-ready.mjs tests pass end-to-end (empty state, auto-registration, stop logging, offline detection, cleanup)
